newsitem.title: UK: SBC Warburg, Brunswick sign Russian bank venture.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg, Brunswick sign Russian bank venture.

text.p: SBC Warburg announced on Monday it was setting up a Russian banking joint venture with Brunswick Investments Ltd.

The joint venture, Brunswick Warburg, will be equally owned by the two partners. It will comprise Brunswick Brokerage, the securities broking subsidiary of BIL and SBC Warburg's existing Russian corporate finance business.
An official speaking on behalf of Brunswick said Martin Anderdesson, the current chief executive of Brunswick Brokerage will be the chief executive of the bank based in Moscow.
Gerard De Geer will be the chairman of the bank.
Brunswick Brokerage has been in Russia since opening up of the Russian equity market in 1994 and has nearly 100 staff working on top Russian blue chip firms.
